title: Acyclic-complex criterion for the canonical unbounded exchange
statement: Let A be an abelian Grothendieck coefficient category in the coefficient universe for schemes [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], also symmetric monoidal, monoidal preadditive and closed, with functorial flat resolutions. Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→Y′, f:X→Y and g:Y′→Y be a commutative square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Suppose the underived sheaf exchange is an isomorphism, f′_* takes exact unbounded complexes of f′_*-acyclic sheaves to exact complexes, and g′^* takes each injective sheaf on X to an f′_*-acyclic sheaf. Then the specified canonical unbounded derived exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] is an isomorphism of functors.

proof.text: Represent each derived object by the functorial K-injective replacement J with injective terms. Localization inverts its augmentation, so naturality of exchange reduces invertibility to the derived object of J.

The right-derived unit at J is invertible by K-injectivity. Each term of g′^*J is f′_*-acyclic. Its unit is invertible too: replace it by a degreewise injective K-injective complex; its cone is an exact complex of acyclic terms, and the hypothesis makes the image cone exact. Naturality of the unit and two-out-of-three give invertibility of the unit before replacement.

The source theorem derivedBaseChangeMap_app_fac identifies the derived exchange, conjugated by the pullback counits and direct-image units, with the localized degreewise underived exchange followed by the target unit. This is the mate identity obtained from the square isomorphism and adjunction counits, not an identification of endpoints alone. All these other factors are isomorphisms by the hypotheses and exact inverse image. Cancel them to prove the component is invertible, then use the componentwise criterion for a natural transformation.

theorem isIso_derivedBaseChangeMap_of_isIso_baseChangeMap (sq : CommSq g' f' f g)
    [IsIso (baseChangeMap A sq)]
    (hF : ∀ M : CochainComplex (Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology A) ℤ, M.Acyclic →
      (∀ n, ((f')_*[A]).rightAcyclic (M.X n)) →
        ((((f')_*[A]).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj M).Acyclic)
    (hI : ∀ I : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A, Injective I →
      ((f')_*[A]).rightAcyclic ((g')^*[A].obj I)) :
    IsIso (derivedBaseChangeMap A sq)
